text:
lina: Noticing a weird pattern in us-west1: GPU nodes fail to attach ephemeral disks intermittently when the nightly cleanup overlaps with scaleup. Attach latency spikes >60s
omar: saw multiple attach timeouts, kubelet marks volume as AttachTimeout and pod sits Pending
ben: checked blockstore metrics
nd KMS call latency is higher during same window (p95 KMS 1.2s -> 3.8s). encrypted attach has extra round trips
linA: sample kernel excerpts from a host that failed attach:
```
[2026-03-21T02:14:12] nvme0: completion timeout, retrying
[2026-03-21T02:14:15] nvme0n1: blk_update_request: I/O error, dev nvme0n1, sector 987654
[2026-03-21T02:14:20] nvme0: controller reset failed
```
sasha: TL;DR: deep-clean jobs (high concurrent rw) + small/new drives + KMS latency = attach path timeouts in storage-proxy -> kube attach layers
ops-phi: scrub config currently:
```yaml
scrub:
  concurrency: 24
  window: "01:00-05:00"
  aggressive_writes: true
```
omar: proposed short fixes: reduce scrub concurrency to 6, add per-host stagger jitter, and temporarily enable offline KMS caching for attach tokens to cut KMS RTTs
ben: also set scrub processes to low IO priority: `ionice -c3 -p $(pgrep -f scrub)` and `nice +10` to deprioritize during peak scale events
sasha: storage-proxy team will enable attach-retry backoff (exponential) and route 20% of attaches to the warm-standby pool to spread load
ops-phi: I'll roll scrub policy change in 3m to us-west1-canaries, monitor attach success and GPU admission queues
linA: create incident? this is causing some preemptible allocation rejections for high-throughput customers
sre-bot: :rotating_light: Incident created INC-2026-321 - us-west1-ephemeral-attach-jitter (severity: medium). Pager: omar
omar: customer comms: keep it vague "storage maintenance and higher-than-normal provisioning latency". ops-phi please tag any high-traffic orgs impacted
ben: after stabilizing, we should run a controlled experiment: run current scrub load on 10% of nodes and measure `attach_latency_p95` + `gpu_ready_delay` to quantify tradeoffs
linA: agreed. timeline: rollback if attach_fail_rate > 1% above baseline in 15m. update here in 20m with metrics. :thumbsup:
